_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request
summary: The Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request provides information required to support the shock qualifications of shipboard equipment, foundations, and/or systems based upon previously approved dynamic shock analyses.
description_purpose: The Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request provides information required to support the shock qualifications of shipboard equipment, foundations and/or systems based upon previously approved dynamic shock analyses.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request shall be in Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request shall include the following:

children.title: Identical Item.
children.content: If the design of a new item is identical to that of one previously approved by a dynamic shock analysis, the Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request shall include the following:

children.title: A copy of the Mathematical Model Report and Dynamic Shock Analysis Report
children.content: upon which the requested extension is based.

children.title: A copy of the acceptance authority correspondence
children.content: which conveyed approval of the previously analyzed equipment, foundation, and system. If not available, reference to the correspondence shall be identified.

children.title: Similar Item.
children.content: If the design of a new item is similar, but not identical, to that of a previously shock analyzed item or where the intended orientation or installation differences cannot be shown to be insignificant from a shock standpoint, the Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request shall include the following:

children.title: Detailed drawings of the tested and untested items
children.content: and delineation of the shipboard installations and orientation of the items. The drawings shall be marked to clarify any design changes that have occurred between the old and new items.

children.title: A Mathematical Model Report and Dynamic Shock Analysis Report
children.content: upon which the requested extension is based.

children.title: The acceptance authority correspondence
children.content: which conveyed approval of the previously analyzed equipment, foundation, and/or system. If not available, reference to the correspondence shall be identified.

children.title: The detailed evaluation of the design, service, orientation
children.content: and installation differences of the analyzed and unanalyzed items, as required by 10.2.3 below.

children.title: Applicable military specifications and associated dates
children.content: of issue for the original analyzed item.

children.title: Comparison.
children.content: The Dynamic Shock Analysis Extension Request shall also include the following:

children.title: Design differences between the new and previously analyzed item.
Differences in shape, orientation, weight, and material composition of parts or assemblies and differences in fabrication or construction.
Differences in allowable stress and deflection criteria.
Differences in continuous operating loads such as torque and system pressure.
Calculations.
children.content: The results of engineering calculations performed in support of these requirements shall also be included. Engineering assumptions attendant to these calculations shall be stated.
